title: Patient Management
description: Patient Management documentation for System Caregiver.
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for System Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (filtered search)
subtasks.purpose: Find patients across assigned practices using program, provider, caregiver, status, vitals and device filters.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient — the filter panel loads with Last Name, First Name, Provider, Caregiver, Status, Vitals, and Serial # (16 digits).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Enter any combination of filters. Provider and Caregiver are dropdowns scoped to the caregiver’s assigned practices.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Click Query — the results grid populates with #, Status, Vitals, Name, Systolic, Diastolic, Pulse, Glucose, Weight, Last Upload, # Readings, and Time.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Click Reset to clear all filters and start a new search. Use the top-right Search: field to further filter the loaded results in-page.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: The empty state “Select filters and click Query to load patients” confirms no query has been executed yet.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by RPM Date)
subtasks.purpose: List RPM-enrolled patients whose RPM service falls within a chosen date range and export the results.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by RPM date) — the “RPM Service Date Range” filter appears with two mm/dd/yyyy pickers.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pick the From and To dates and click Query — the grid shows #, Status, Vitals, Patient Name, DOB, Modal #, Serial #, RPM Start Date, Upload Date/Time, Measurement Days, Service Time, and Eligible CPT Codes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sort by any column (e.g. RPM Start Date) using the header arrow; use the top-right Search: to filter loaded rows.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use Print to open a print preview, Export to download the roster (CSV / Excel), or Email to send it to a linked recipient. Reset clears the range and results.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by CCM Date)
subtasks.purpose: List CCM-enrolled patients whose CCM service window falls in a chosen range, with billing status per row.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by CCM date) — the “CCM Service Date Range” picker appears.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pick From / To dates and click Query — the grid renders #, Status, Patient Name, DOB, Chronic Conditions, Enrollment Date, Last Activity, Service Time, Eligible CPT Codes, and Billing.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Sort by Enrollment Date (default sort arrow shown) or any other header. Filter loaded rows via the Search: field.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: Use Print / Export / Email to distribute the roster; Reset clears filters and results. The “No patients found” state indicates no rows match the range.
